channel.title: Paksh: Crime & Law
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.title: US Senators Urge White House AI Chief on Cyber Vulnerabilities
item.description: Two US senators have urged Jay Clayton, the director of national intelligence and AI czar, to identify and fix vulnerabilities in the US's artificial intelligence systems. This call follows concerns raised by Democrats about potential… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Students Sue After AI Mistook Doritos Bag for Gun
item.description: Four current and former high school students in Maryland have filed a lawsuit alleging they were traumatized after being handcuffed and detained by police. The incident occurred a year prior when an AI alert mistakenly identified a bag of… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 0 · Right 0.

item.title: Russian Oligarch Offers Ex-Wife 1% of Divorce Settlement
item.description: A Russian oligarch has offered his ex-wife 1% of her £2.2 billion (approximately $30 billion) divorce demand. The case is being heard in a London court, where the ex-wife is pursuing a share of the fortune. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: London Transport Data Breach Affects Hundreds of Thousands
item.description: Transport for London (TfL) has reported a data breach affecting over 260,000 users of its Oyster photocard system. The breach may have impacted children among the affected individuals. The exact nature and extent of the data compromised… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Canadian Police to Announce Updated Fugitive List
item.description: Canadian police forces are scheduled to reveal an updated list of their most wanted fugitives on Thursday morning. The announcement will be made by police forces across Canada. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: French Officers Sentenced for Beating Black Man
item.description: A French police officer has been sentenced to prison for the killing of a Black man during a traffic stop. A prosecutor had sought 4 to 6 years in prison for French officers accused of beating the Black man. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Iraqi court sentences six French nationals to life for IS membership
item.description: An Iraqi court has sentenced six French nationals to life in prison after finding them guilty of joining the Islamic State (IS) group. The sentences were handed down by the Karkh Criminal Court in Baghdad. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Footballer Ivan Toney's trial date bid refused
item.description: Footballer Ivan Toney's attempt to reschedule his trial date to prevent a clash with the Euro 2028 tournament has been unsuccessful. The court refused his bid to move the trial. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Julio Iglesias Investigated for Sexual Misconduct in Spain
item.description: Singer Julio Iglesias is under investigation by the Spanish High Court for alleged sexual misconduct. The probe was opened by the court into allegations of sexual abuse against the singer. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 1.

item.title: Marathon Champion Jepchirchir Receives 3-Year Doping Ban
item.description: Kenya's Olympic and world marathon champion Peres Jepchirchir has been handed a three-year ban for doping violations. The ban was reported by multiple international news outlets. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Israel launches new ground operation in central Gaza
item.description: Israel has launched a new ground operation in central Gaza, with dozens reported to be fleeing the area. This development follows an International Court of Justice (ICJ) ruling concerning genocide in Myanmar, which has raised new legal… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 1.

item.title: EU Commission Targeted by AI-Powered Cyberattack
item.description: The European Commission was targeted in a cyberattack in October that utilized artificial intelligence, according to an official. The attack reportedly compromised personal data of employees. The European Commission has not yet commented… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 5 · Right 1.

item.title: DMK Leader Accused in ₹1,427 Crore Illegal Sand Mining Case
item.description: The Directorate of Vigilance and Anti-Corruption (DVAC) has accused senior DMK leader and former Tamil Nadu minister Duraimurugan as the main accused in a conspiracy involving government officials and private contractors for illegal river… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 0 · Right 2.

item.title: Woman Allegedly Plots Murder of Husband's Friend After Suspecting Affair
item.description: A woman, identified as Mona Agrawal, has been accused of orchestrating the murder of Varsha Turkar, a friend of her husband, in Gondia, Maharashtra. The alleged motive stemmed from Agrawal's suspicion that her husband was having an affair… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Supreme Court to Hear KG Basin Gas Dispute Mediation
item.description: The Supreme Court is set to hear the KG Basin gas dispute, with the Centre raising no objection to former Supreme Court Justice Ranjana Prakash Desai acting as a mediator. The Centre has agreed to Justice Desai's mediation in the dispute. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Violence Erupts in Bangladesh, Nobel Laureate Yunus's Ancestral Home Burned
item.description: Violence has again erupted in Bangladesh, with reports of bomb blasts in Dhaka and the burning of the ancestral home of Nobel laureate Muhammad Yunus. The Awami League has called for a nationwide strike. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Fugitive accused in Kerala murder case deported from UAE
item.description: Indian authorities have secured the deportation of Raghesh Unnikochan, a fugitive wanted in connection with a murder case in Kerala. The Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI), in coordination with the Ministry of External Affairs and… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Tamil Nadu Investment Agency Sacks Staff Over Data Leak Allegations
item.description: Fifteen contract employees of Guidance Tamil Nadu, the state's investment promotion agency, have been terminated following allegations that confidential information about prospective industrial investments was leaked to officials in Andhra… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 0 · Right 2.

item.title: NGT Orders Action Against 53 Delhi Hotels and Guest Houses
item.description: The National Green Tribunal (NGT) has ordered officials to take action against 53 hotels and guest houses in Delhi. Sub-Divisional Magistrates (SDMs) are to submit reports on the matter. The NGT's directive has reportedly caused… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Two separate road accidents kill seven in India
item.description: Two separate road accidents in India have resulted in the deaths of seven young men. In Palwal, a collision between a car and a motorcycle claimed the life of an NHAI employee. In Balrampur, a head-on collision between two motorcycles… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Tree falls on motorcycle, killing newly married techie in Hyderabad
item.description: A newly married software engineer died in Hyderabad when a tree fell on her motorcycle in Nagole. The incident occurred while she was riding the bike. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Mumbai Restaurants Face License Suspensions Over Food Safety Issues
item.description: The Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has suspended the licenses of nine restaurants in Mumbai due to food safety violations. While one report specified nine establishments, another mentioned six, including notable eateries like 5 Spice… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Journalist Arrested Amid Allegations of Coercion in Rape Complaint Against MLA
item.description: A man has been arrested for allegedly coercing a minor to file a 'false' rape complaint against a Jharkhand Congress MLA. Separately, police reportedly raided the Ranchi office of digital news channel Bharatmitra, whose journalist Abhishek… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Elephant linked to 16 deaths tranquilized and radio-collared in Chhattisgarh
item.description: An elephant, believed to be responsible for 16 deaths, has been captured and fitted with a radio collar in Chhattisgarh following a six-day operation. The operation to tranquilize and collar the animal concluded after nearly a week. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Two Suspected Drug Smugglers Arrested in Mahasamund with Large Ganja Seizure
item.description: Police in Mahasamund have arrested two suspected drug smugglers and seized a large quantity of ganja. One report states 38 lakh rupees worth of contraband was recovered, while another reports the seizure to be worth 48.95 lakh rupees. The… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Film Stars Back Jafar Panahi Amid Iranian Prison Sentence
item.description: Over 200 film figures, including Hollywood actors Mark Ruffalo and Tilda Swinton, have expressed support for Iranian director Jafar Panahi following his new prison sentence. Other notable figures joining the appeal include Michael Moore… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Indian Man Found Dead in Burning Car in Canada; Targeted Killing Suspected
item.description: A 25-year-old Indian man, identified as Tushar Sharma, was found dead inside a car that had been set on fire in British Columbia, Canada. Canadian police are investigating the incident as a suspected targeted killing. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Former Clerk Arrested in Multi-Crore Corruption Case in West Bengal
item.description: The Criminal Investigation Department (CID) of West Bengal has arrested a former Head Clerk of Taki Municipality in connection with a multi-crore corruption case. The arrested official had retired from his post. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Amit Shah Inaugurates Counter-Terrorism Conference in New Delhi
item.description: Union Home Minister Amit Shah inaugurated a counter-terrorism conference in New Delhi. The conference focused on strategies to combat terrorism. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Ariyil Shukkoor Murder Case: 13 Convicted, Key CPI(M) Leaders Acquitted
item.description: A court has convicted 13 individuals in connection with the murder of Ariyil Shukkoor. Seven of the convicts, including the prime accused Sumesh, have been sentenced to life imprisonment. Two prominent CPI(M) leaders, Jayarajan and Rajesh… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Nvidia Faces Scrutiny Over Ex-Executive's Alleged China Chip Diversions
item.description: Nvidia is facing renewed scrutiny following allegations that its former executive Jay Puri and his wife, Cenly Chen, diverted chips to China. Short-seller Muddy Waters has raised questions about Supermicro and chip shipments, linking them… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 1.

item.title: Bombay High Court Halts Demolition of Dawood Ibrahim-Linked Mumbai Building
item.description: The Bombay High Court has halted the demolition of an 87-year-old building in Mumbai that was once linked to Dawood Ibrahim. The building had been classified as C-1, indicating it was a dangerous structure. Bulldozers had begun moving in… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 0.

item.title: Saif Ali Khan receives death threat; police investigate accused in murder case
item.description: Actor Saif Ali Khan has received a death threat. Police have launched a probe into the matter. The threat is reportedly from an accused in the Baba Siddique murder case. Shiv Sena's Neelam Gorhe stated that the government will take action. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 2.

item.title: UP CM Visits Gorakhpur Amidst JCB Accident Controversy
item.description: Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath visited Gorakhpur to meet the family of Aryavardhan Singh, a child who died in an accident. The incident occurred as a JCB, reportedly returning from Samajwadi Party leader Akhilesh Yadav's… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 4 · Right 0.

item.title: Man Detained After Forcing Entry into Delhi Airport Terminal
item.description: A man was detained at Delhi's Indira Gandhi International Airport after he forcefully entered Terminal 3 by jumping over a wall. Central Industrial Security Force (CISF) personnel intercepted him within seconds of his breach. The incident… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 3.

item.title: NEET UG Paper Leak: Court Orders Framing of Charges Against 14 Accused
item.description: A court has ordered that charges be framed against 14 accused in the NEET UG paper leak case. The Rouse Avenue Court will frame the charges on November 21 and will hear the case daily. The investigation is ongoing, with authorities… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 1.

item.title: NHAI pilots SMS alert system for uninsured vehicles at toll plazas
item.description: The National Highways Authority of India (NHAI) has begun a pilot trial of a new system at the Mundka toll plaza on Urban Extension Road-II (UER-II) in Delhi. This system aims to identify vehicles operating on highways without valid… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 2.

item.title: Delhi Police argues reel‑makers not covered by journalist protection in Supreme Court
item.description: Delhi Police submitted an affidavit to the Supreme Court asserting that social media influencers, content creators and reel‑makers do not qualify as journalists and therefore are not entitled to the press‑protective provisions that apply… Coverage: Left 4 · Centre 4 · Right 2.

item.title: Supreme Court Takes Action Over Remarks Against Judges and CJI
item.description: The Supreme Court has taken action in multiple instances involving remarks made against judges and the Chief Justice of India (CJI). The Supreme Court Bar Association (SCBA) moved the Supreme Court to initiate contempt proceedings against… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 7 · Right 3.

item.title: Supreme Court Dismisses Plea to Ban Animal Sacrifice
item.description: The Supreme Court of India has dismissed a petition that sought to ban the sacrifice of animals during religious ceremonies. The court's decision upholds the practice, which is part of certain religious traditions. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.
